main_measure.name: slope of excess next-day return on forecast (forecast > 0, pooled)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean excess next-day return, top fifth minus bottom fifth of forecasts

decided_by: The slope is positive with t >= 2 and the top fifth's mean excess return is above the bottom fifth's (confirm rule).
reading: The situation is a down day (close below the previous close in the same window, or a positive raw component value on a window's first bar) on the long side; the slope is an OLS fit with intercept whose t uses standard errors clustered by UTC day (with the usual G/(G-1)*(N-1)/(N-K) correction); the top and bottom fifths are the highest and lowest floor(n/5) cases by forecast, ties broken stably by record order.
